compare.before: Hand-entered time sheets bring errors you only find at month end.
compare.after: Terminals capture every check-in and calculate hours, overtime and leave automatically.

compare.before: One person can clock in for another.
compare.after: Fingerprint, face and card checks tie every event to the right person.

compare.before: Reports arrive days after the pay period closes.
compare.after: Managers see live attendance and exceptions as they happen.

compare.before: Audit trails are rebuilt by hand from scattered records.
compare.after: Every event is logged, and the full history exports on demand.

features.title: Biometric attendance
features.text: Fingerprint with anti-fake-finger detection, contactless face recognition with liveness checks, and RFID cards on their own or combined for secure areas.

features.title: Real-time dashboard
features.text: Live present and absent counts, department breakdowns and shift filters, with late arrivals and long absences flagged automatically.

features.title: Employees and shifts
features.text: Guided and bulk biometric enrollment, department hierarchies, rotating shifts, overtime thresholds and break rules.

features.title: Reports and analytics
features.text: Daily, weekly, monthly and per-employee reports, scheduled by email and exported to Excel, PDF or CSV for payroll.

features.title: Leave workflows
features.text: Requests go to the manager, then HR, and balances update on approval across sick, paid, emergency and other leave types.

features.title: Role-based access
features.text: Administrators, HR managers, supervisors and employees each see only what their role requires.

reliability.title: Keeps working offline
reliability.text: Terminals buffer events locally and sync automatically when the network returns.

reliability.title: Encrypted and protected
reliability.text: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with multi-factor authentication for privileged accounts.

reliability.title: Complete audit trail
reliability.text: Every attendance and administrative action is logged and exportable.

reliability.title: Connects to your systems
reliability.text: A RESTful API supports integration with payroll and HR platforms.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.text: Install the terminals, configure the network, migrate employee data and test.

phases.title: Enrollment
phases.text: Enroll employees, train administrators, HR and supervisors, and run alongside your current process to confirm accuracy.

phases.title: Go-live
phases.text: Switch over fully, retire the manual process and get close support through the transition.

flow.title: Biometric terminals

flow.title: Application server
flow.text: Node.js and Express API with live WebSocket updates

flow.title: Web dashboard
flow.text: React, in any desktop or mobile browser
